description: Elections Commission - Notify the name of A. P. Ranasinghe as a member of the Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of a member, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new elected member, which falls directly under electoral processes and matters related to local government elections.
